items.subject: mRNA-1273 cost-effectiveness analysis
items.statement: Incremental cost-effectiveness ratio is $22,648 per QALY gained using a 10-year time horizon, US payer perspective, and 3% discount rate

items.subject: COVID-19 disease burden
items.statement: Annual hospitalizations attributable to COVID-19 are estimated at 241,434, with direct medical costs exceeding $21 billion and indirect costs including productivity losses of an estimated $48 billion annually
items.supporting_quote: Annual hospitalizations attributable to COVID-19 are estimated at 241,434, with direct medical costs exceeding $21 billion. Indirect costs including productivity losses add an estimated $48 billion annually.

items.subject: mRNA-1273 budget impact analysis
items.statement: For a plan size of 1,000,000 covered lives with 58% vaccination rate: Year 1 net budget impact is $6M increase, Year 3 cumulative offset is $13M in avoided hospitalizations, and 5-year net savings is $14M
items.supporting_quote:
Plan Size Modeled: 1,000,000 covered lives
Vaccination Rate Assumed: 58%
Year 1 Net Budget Impact: $6M increase
Year 3 Cumulative Offset: $13M in avoided hospitalizations
5-Year Net Savings: $14M

items.subject: mRNA-1273 formulary recommendation
items.statement: Moderna, Inc. recommends preferred formulary placement with no prior authorization restrictions
items.supporting_quote: Moderna, Inc. recommends preferred formulary placement with no prior authorization restrictions.
